title: Se me pasó la mano
desc: One step past funny, in a patio that has gone quiet
setting: You said something about Chino's new job and the six men in the patio have all stopped talking at once.

options.es: Se me pasó la mano. Perdoname, Chino.
options.en: I went too far. Forgive me, Chino.
options.feedback: Say it in the same ten seconds, to the man himself, by name. Se me pasó la mano is the exact phrase for having gone one step past the line.
Everybody knows it was a joke. That is not what went wrong and saying it does not fix it.
You did, everyone heard it, and pretending not to notice leaves it lying in the middle of the patio all afternoon.

steps.speaker: Chino
steps.es: No, tranquilo. Si es verdad que del otro me botaron.
steps.en: No, it is fine. It is true they did sack me from the other one.

options.es: Igual estuvo de más. No debí decirlo.
options.en: It was still out of order. I should not have said it.
options.feedback: He let you off and you did not take it. Refusing the easy exit once is what makes the apology count.
You took the exit he offered. It closes the afternoon and it does not close the thing itself.

options.es: Ves, entonces no fue tan grave.
options.en: See, so it was not that bad.
options.feedback: He was being generous. Using his generosity as proof that you were right is worse than the joke was.

steps.speaker: Marcos
steps.es: El vacilón es del trabajo viejo, no del nuevo. Del nuevo no se toca.
steps.en: The teasing is about the old job, not the new one. You do not touch the new one.

options.es: Ya entendí. Lo que le duele hoy no se toca.
options.en: I understand. What still hurts today is off limits.
options.feedback: That is the line and nobody was ever going to explain it to you in advance. Everything is fair game except the thing that is still open.

options.es: Es difícil saber hasta dónde se puede.
options.en: It is hard to know where the line is.
options.feedback: It is, and you have just been told where it is for this table. That is as close to a rule as you will get.

options.en: You lot say worse things to each other.
options.feedback: They do, and they have twenty years of knowing what each other can take. You have four.

steps.speaker: Chino
steps.es: Ya, ya. Andá a traerme una birra y quedamos a mano.
steps.en: All right, all right. Go and get me a beer and we are even.

options.es: Dos te traigo. Y la otra me toca a mí aguantar.
options.en: I will bring you two. And next time it is my turn to take it.
options.feedback: The beer is the repair and offering yourself as the next target is the receipt. That is how it is finished here, not with a long conversation.

options.en: I will bring it right now.
options.feedback: Good enough. He has ended it and you are doing what he asked.

options.es: Traigo la birra, pero de verdad me quedé mal.
options.en: I will bring the beer, but I really do feel bad.
options.feedback: You already apologised twice. A third one asks him to keep forgiving you when he has said it is over.
